Don’t miss FOX’s The Faithful: Women of the Bible, a powerful three-part biblical event starting March 22. Filmed on location in Rome and Matera, Italy, this landmark drama brings the stories of Genesis to life through the women whose lives were woven into God’s unfolding plan.

The series premieres Sunday, March 22 (8–10 PM ET/PT) on FOX and continues over three weeks, culminating Easter Sunday, April 5. Episodes will also stream the next day on Hulu.
